Challenges We Solve</h2><div class="prose-content mt-5 text-[#6B7280]"><p>Modern organizations operate across employees, contractors, vendors, partners, service providers, customers, and machine identities.</p>
<p>As organizations grow, identity becomes increasingly difficult to secure, govern, and automate.</p>
<p>Common challenges include:</p></div></div></div><div class="mt-9 grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"><article class="premium-card overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[#E5E7EB] bg-white access, why they have access, who approved it, whether access is still required, which accounts are privileged, and which accounts are orphaned.</p></div></article><article class="premium-card overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[#E5E7EB] bg-white shadow-[0_8px_24px_rgba(7,24,39,.05)]"><div class="p-6"><span class="semantic-icon inline-grid shrink-0 place-items-center size-14 x2="16" y1="11" y2="11"></line></svg></span><h3 class="mt-3 text-xl font-bold text-[#071827]">Delayed Access Removal</h3><p class="mt-3 leading-7 text-[#6B7280]">Former employees, contractors, Review owners need clear entitlement context, managers need simple approval workflows, and audit teams need reliable proof that inappropriate access was removed.</p></div></article><article class="premium-card overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[#E5E7EB] bg-white shadow-[0_8px_24px_rgba(7,24,39,.05)]"><div class="p-6"><span class="semantic-icon inline-grid shrink-0 place-items-center size-14 text-[#E31E24]" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-cable size-11" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M17 19a1 1 0 0 1-1-1v-2a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2a1 1 0 0 1-1 1z"></path><path d="M17 21v-2"></path><path d="M19 14V6.5a1 1 0 0 0-7 0v11a1 1 0 0 1-7 0V10"></path><path d="M21 21v-2"></path><path d="M3 5V3"></path><path d="M4 10a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h4a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v2a2 2 0 0 1-2 2z"></path><path d="M7 5V3"></path></svg></span><h3 class="mt-3 text-xl font-bold text-[#071827]">Operational Dependency on Custom Integrations</h3><p class="mt-3 leading-7 text-[#6B7280]">Identity operations frequently rely on institutional knowledge, custom scripts, and external vendors for routine identity changes.</p></div></article></div></div></section><section class="section-space bg-[#071827] text-white"><div class="site-container"><div class="max-w-3xl"><p class="text-sm font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[.14em] text-[#B9C49E]">Identity foundation</p><h2 class="text-balance mt-3 text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight md:text-4xl">Identity Security, <span class="highlight-gradient">Governance &amp; font-bold tracking-tight text-[#071827] md:text-4xl">Frequently Asked <span class="highlight-gradient">Questions</span></h2><div class="faq-list mt-8 grid gap-3"><details class="faq-item rounded-xl border border-[#E5E7EB] bg-white p-5"><summary class="faq-summary cursor-pointer font-bold text-[#071827]">What does Tecnics do?</summary><p class="mt-3 leading-7 text-[#6B7280]">Tecnics provides identity security consulting, implementation, integration, optimization, and managed IAM operations. We help organizations secure access, govern identities, automate lifecycle processes, and operate identity programs across complex enterprise environments.</p></details><details class="faq-item rounded-xl border border-[#E5E7EB] bg-white p-5"><summary class="faq-summary cursor-pointer font-bold text-[#071827]">Which identity platforms does Tecnics support?</summary><p class="mt-3 leading-7 text-[#6B7280]">Tecnics supports Okta, Auth0, Microsoft Entra, Idira (formerly CyberArk), SAP Identity, Active Directory, cloud identity services, and connected enterprise systems. We also integrate Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, custom applications, databases, and automation runbooks into identity workflows.</p></details><details class="faq-item rounded-xl border border-[#E5E7EB] bg-white p-5"><summary class="faq-summary cursor-pointer font-bold text-[#071827]">Can Tecnics help with Okta and Microsoft Entra coexistence?</summary><p class="mt-3 leading-7 text-[#6B7280]">Yes. Tecnics helps organizations define where Okta excels, where Microsoft Entra fits, how both platforms should coexist, and how to build automation, governance, and operational runbooks across the combined environment.</p></details><details class="faq-item rounded-xl border border-[#E5E7EB] bg-white p-5"><summary class="faq-summary cursor-pointer font-bold text-[#071827]">Does Tecnics integrate Workday and ServiceNow?</summary><p class="mt-3 leading-7 text-[#6B7280]">Yes. Tecnics integrates Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, and similar systems on top of identity platforms such as Okta, Microsoft Entra, and Idira to support joiner-mover-leaver automation, access requests, approvals, fulfillment, remediation, and reporting.</p></details><details class="faq-item rounded-xl border border-[#E5E7EB] bg-white p-5"><summary class="faq-summary cursor-pointer font-bold text-[#071827]">Can Tecnics provide managed IAM operations after implementation?</summary><p class="mt-3 leading-7 text-[#6B7280]">Yes.
